values.note: DNR rate table: modern 20/30-amp sites $26, semi-modern $21, rustic $20 (semi-modern sites are rustic when the bathrooms close). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Lake Gogebic / campground: Modern 20/30 AMP $26, Semi-modern $21, Rustic $20; 'Some semi-modern sites are available during the peak camping season. These sites will be rustic when bathrooms close.') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakegogebic ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: midnrreservations.com resources (118 campsites: 108 'Electric Only' with 20/30 amps, 37 of them also 50 amps, 10 'Not Available'; Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'No' on 117, 'Yes' only on the campground host site) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakegogebic (Modern Campground: 'Electrical service'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Modern campground 105 sites, semi-modern campground 22 (DNR park page); the booking site also sells 20 overflow sites. 13 of 118 booking-site campsites are pull-through; pad lengths 25-90 ft, mostly grass.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakegogebic (Lake Gogebic Modern Campground 'Number of sites: 105', 'Pull-through sites available'; Semi-Modern Campground 'Number of sites: 22') + midnrreservations.com resources (Pull Through Yes 13 / No 105; Site Length 25-90), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakegogebic (Modern: 'Modern campground, Sanitation station, Toilet & shower building'; Semi-Modern: 'Toilet & shower building, Vault toilet'; tiny house: 'Potable water can be found in the campground or at park headquarters') + DNR rates page ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station, water spigots'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The modern campground (105 of the park's 127 sites) closes Oct. 13, 2026 through June 7, 2027 to remove about 800 emerald-ash-borer-infested trees; the DNR notice does not mention the 22-site semi-modern campground.

status.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakegogebic ('Lake Gogebic's modern campground closed Oct. 13, 2026 through June 7, 2027 to remove approximately 800 trees infested by emerald ash borer'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed fees $20 (rustic) to $26 (modern 20/30-amp) with the Recreation Passport in fees.note; season May 1 - Oct 31 (manual) unchanged. Added 50-amp electric (37 sites; 20/30 at 108), no water/sewer at public sites, 127 sites (105 modern + 22 semi-modern) with 13 pull-throughs, modern facilities with sanitation station, reservable on midnrreservations.com. Recorded the DNR closure: modern campground closed Oct 13, 2026 - June 7, 2027 for emerald ash borer tree removal. --AWH note kept as is. Not stated: max rig length, booking window/max stay for this park (left inherited).
flags: Temporary closure: DNR park page banner 'Lake Gogebic's modern campground closed Oct. 13, 2026 through June 7, 2027 to remove approximately 800 trees infested by emerald ash borer'. Recorded as status temporarily_closed (reopens June 7, 2027) because the modern campground is 105 of the 127 sites; the 22-site semi-modern campground is not named in the closure, so a human may prefer to treat it as a partial closure (note only).
Website: the entry's website is the bare reservation home page https://midnrreservations.com/; the park's own page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakegogebic.
Phone: the entry has none; the park office is 906-842-3341 (DNR park page).
